note: Differences from the Fastify baseline that were reviewed and accepted. `pnpm contract:parity` reports a matching difference as explained instead of failing. Anything not listed fails the gate.

accepted.reason: New operation (2026-11-11, AUTHORIZATION Q25): restore a deactivated tenant inside its retention window; permission platform.tenant.restore (Super Admin only); error TENANT_DEACTIVATION_EXPIRED.
The derived (superset) domain error codes of the platform-tenants module now include TENANT_DEACTIVATION_EXPIRED, which only the restore action raises.
Tenant detail responses gained the nullable field tenant.restorableUntil (Q25); allowedActions can now contain "restore".

Edge hardening (2026-11-11): creating and side-effect POSTs accept the optional Idempotency-Key header (409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT) and sign-in/write routes have per-route rate limits (429 RATE_LIMITED).
Same change: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT and RATE_LIMITED are now possible on these operations.
Same change: the Idempotency-Key header parameter and the 400/409/429 responses are documented.
New operations (2026-11-11): read access to the tenant audit log (audit_log.view_all) and the platform audit log (platform.audit_log.view); filters actor, action, date range, result.

New operations of the pipelines and triggers module (docs/modules/pipelines-triggers/SPEC.md §8, implementation part C, 2026-11-12): pipelines (list, create, get, edit metadata, enable, disable, soft delete), immutable configuration versions (list, get, publish N+1 with expectedVersion), manual run (Idempotency-Key required), the pipeline's execution requests and trigger decisions (read only), the dry-run of triggers and the wizard options. Permissions pipeline.view / pipeline.manage / pipeline.manage_fork_policy / pipeline.delete / execution.view / execution.run (workspace scope). No route updates or deletes a configuration version.

New operations of the pipelines and triggers module (docs/modules/pipelines-triggers/SPEC.md §8, implementation part C, 2026-11-12): pipelines (list, create, get, edit metadata, enable, disable, soft delete), immutable configuration versions (list, get, publish N+1 with expectedVersion), manual run (Idempotency-Key required), the pipeline's execution requests and trigger decisions (read only), the dry-run of triggers and the wizard options. Permissions pipeline.view / pipeline.manage / pipeline.manage_fork_policy / pipeline.delete / execution.view / execution.run (workspace scope). No route updates or deletes a configuration version. 2026-11-13: the trigger decisions of GET /pipelines/{id}/trigger-decisions gained `sourceType` (scm_event, schedule_slot, manual), `scmDeliveryId`, `scheduleSlot`, `manualKey` and the `sourceType` filter (SPEC §7.8).

New operations of the repositories and GitHub integration module (docs/modules/repositories-github/SPEC.md §8): integrations catalog and installation lifecycle, repositories, and the GitHub webhook route.

New operation (2026-11-12, SPEC §16.2, owner-approved): "Use an existing installation", step 1 of the two-step discovery. Permission workspace_integration.manage in the workspace; tenant setting off gives 403 workspace_linking_disabled; returns the same { authorizeUrl } as authorize but mints a state with the purpose discover and no installation id. Step 2 is the existing POST /integrations/github/links, which answers 200 { mode: "discover", truncated, candidates } for such a state and links nothing (201 for a linking state, unchanged). No operation of the Fastify baseline is involved.

New operations (2026-11-12, SPEC §18 / ADR-012, AUTHORIZATION Q26): workspace-level GitHub linking (start, authorize, test connection, workspace unlink, repository allow-list); permissions workspace_integration.view / workspace_integration.manage (workspace scope). Replaces the 2026-11-11 routing operations GET/PUT /workspaces/{ws}/integrations[/{linkId}] and the tenant-level link operations (start, authorize, link, refresh, scope, unlink under /integrations/github/installations), which no longer exist; none of them was in the Fastify baseline.

New operations of the user-preferences module (docs/modules/user-preferences/SPEC.md §8, 2026-11-13, owner decision): the signed-in user's own interface preferences (accent colour) in the active tenant. Tenant audience, no permission, no id in path/body/query, PUT rate-limited (write profile).
